title: Charles: "I Want To Win. I Want Cardano To Be #1 On CoinMarketCap." Angry Crypto Reacts
description:
Cardano $ADA 24h trade volume surpasses $480,000,000 according to CoinGecko. Cardano TVL surpasses 549M $ADA according to DeFiLlama, a sustained uptrend since September. Coinbase Wrapped $ADA ($cbADA) now surpasses 4,600 holders according to BaseScan, highlighting rising interest in cross-chain Cardano. Charles Hoskinson updates his X profile picture and banner. "Building a better world is a war worth winning. Cardano: a Proof of Stake foundation. Midnight: Privacy is our right. Decentralization, sustainability, interoperability, privacy." Cardano Founder Charles Hoskinson says "I want to win. I want $ADA to be #1 on CoinMarketCap. I really do. I think there's no reason why we can't achieve that, but we have to continue to invest in our technology." Charles Hoskinson says "you can't build a cryptocurrency without a holistic stack-level view. Infrastructure is what you can do, utility is what you actually do, and experiences are how you do it." Charles Hoskinson says "the Draper Orion Fund got approved. We've started collaborating with them. They'll really take the bull by its horns in trying to make sure capital can flow to the utility side—and we can upgrade and enhance dApps and DeFi." Charles Hoskinson says "we have to make sure our dApp and DeFi ecosystem is front and center, that they have a customer acquisition strategy," highlighting the "big 4 KPIs for growth: Monthly active users, TVL, transaction volume, and token price." Charles Hoskinson explains the customer journey for Bitcoin DeFi: "We want to live in a world where somebody on the Bitcoin network can click a button, they don't have to do a lot of stuff, and magically in a Taproot address, their Bitcoin gets lent to a stablecoin on Cardano, like $USDCx or $USDM, then it goes into a yield-bearing contract, it generates a return, and through a DEX, gets converted into $BTC and deposited into their Taproot address. With Midnight, it would also be private, that entire transaction." Charles Hoskinson says Bitcoin DeFi will "create a lot of TXs, revenue, and TVL—multiple dApps being used, you got some Midnight magic. That end-to-end circuit for me is not optional, it's a KPI we must achieve and demonstrate this year with Pogun." Charles Hoskinson says "another part of the strategy, is how do we get 5-10 Tier-1 dApps running on Cardano. I mean $1B+ in market cap, they're on Binance, they have liquidity, multi-chain, they bring a lot of value, users, TXs, and get venture capital interested." Charles Hoskinson says "Hydra is a means to an end. A person will use Hydra in DeltaDeFi to make it a good DEX, with Glacier Drop to facilitate a large airdrop, with Hydra events to power a fast vending machine, with Hydra DOOM to play a video game." Strike, with on-chain perpetuals, says "New feature alert: TWAP (time weighted average price) is now LIVE. Better execution and more control so you can strike faster." Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard says "capital, technology innovation, and pilots always hit 1 big obstacle, identity and verification. 43 different regulators around the world are already saying if you don't have LEI, you don't need to come and talk to me." Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard says "design trust in, or manage risk later. That's why we work with GBBC, to get a risk management framework in place for the new architecture—the distributed decentralized architecture who can battle Quantum and AI agents." TapTools says The Motley Fool tells its 30M+ monthly readers: Cardano is quietly building a moat — and the market may be underpricing it. Cardano ranks #1 in all-time code commits among all L1 blockchains. Everstake says "Cardano leading in this metric highlights a meaningful shift in where engineering effort is concentrated. This points to ongoing protocol improvements, expanding infrastructure, deeper ecosystem development." Watcher Guru reports: Treasury Secretary Bessent says crypto is going to be a "very important payment rail." Tesla $TSLA reveals none of its $900,000,000 Bitcoin was sold in Q1 2026. Finally, let's talk about prices and the future of altcoins, finishing off with Cardano's post-quantum approach, and the intersection of distributed decentralized ledgers, cybersecurity, and privacy-enhancing techology.

#Cardano #ADA #CryptoNews
